Psychologist Jordan Peterson discusses women's studies with Rogan in an excerpt drawn from episode 877 of the Joe Rogan Experience. Peterson, then rising fast as a public critic of campus culture, states his case in the clipped, lecture-like style his fans know.

He argues that women's studies grew from ideology more than from open inquiry, and he questions what the field teaches about men and women. Rogan draws him out on how such programs shape students and policy. The excerpt preserves a key piece of Peterson's early public case, the academic fight that first made him famous beyond his classroom.
